description: This file contains C source code for handling DHCP messages and options, including functions for comparing, copying, parsing, validating, and adding DHCP options, as well as managing DHCP message structures.

methods.name: compare_option
methods.description: Compares two DHCP options, returning 0 if they are the same.

methods.name: dhcp_copy_option
methods.description: Copies a DHCP option, allocating new memory for the data.

methods.name: dhcp_cleanup_option
methods.description: Cleans up (frees) a DHCP option's allocated data, used for copied options.

methods.name: dhcp_clear_option_info
methods.description: Clears and frees all DHCP options within a dhcp_option_info structure.

methods.name: dhcp_parse_options
methods.description: Parses DHCP options from provided data, constructing a linked list of options and setting relevant fields in dhcp_option_info.

methods.name: dhcp_parse_msg
methods.description: Parses DHCP message options, file, and sname fields based on overload flags.

methods.name: dhcp_validate_msg
methods.description: Validates DHCP message type and operation code.

methods.name: dhcp_add_ipaddr_option
methods.description: Adds an IP address option to buffer, returning the size of the option.
